subject: design/native-routing-policy-v1
statement: A repository override may replace exactly one complete harness-role catalog when its schema and resolver compatibility identities match the runtime, every entry passes the same qualification rules, and existing repository authorization approves it. There is no field merge between defaults and override, no inherited candidate, and no raw argument escape hatch.
